title: Add receipt opt-in/opt-out preference to spec
description: deliveryReceipts is surfaced to senders automatically with no capability flag or opt-in. ReadPosition (local read tracking) is always-on. Need a receiptSharing field (or equivalent) at account level and/or per-Chat level so a user can disable sending read receipts. Affects draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (Chat object, PresenceStatus or new account pref) and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md (Peer/receipt behavior when sender has opted out).
close_reason: Added receiptSharing to PresenceStatus (chat-00.md:779), sender suppression to Peer/receipt (federation-00.md:301), and Read Receipt Privacy security note (chat-00.md:1433)
